intro: Following Madame Eva's divination, this investigation leads from her parlor to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire. It centers on tracing the origins of the journal recovered from the ruins of Sven Yorgen's ransacked farmstead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is your book back, friend, and I bid you fortune with your search. If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.
And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.
I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. I sold this book a month ago to a shady person. He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
